summary: Prepare cost-centre budgets, track commitments and explain variances. Explore this practical five-day training course.
lede: Budget setting and control training helps budget officers, finance staff and cost-centre managers prepare and monitor usable budgets. Learners practise building cost-centre estimates, phasing revenue and expenditure, tracking commitments in spreadsheets, and explaining budget-to-actual variances. They also consolidate submissions, review assumptions and record corrective actions, with foundation-level introductions to rolling forecasts and capital appraisal.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare budget submissions, monitor delegated spending or explain financial performance. It suits foundation-level learners who need a practical grasp of cost-centre budgets and monthly control routines.
modules: Chart of Accounts and Cost Centres
prerequisites: Basic numeracy and familiarity with routine workplace budgets or expenditure records will help. No coding is required. Access to Excel is useful for spreadsheet exercises.
